question: Which supreme court judge has surved in international court of justice?
text:
If you mean the **Supreme Court of India**, two of its judges went on to serve on the **International Court of Justice (ICJ)**:

- **R. S. Pathak**, a former Chief Justice of India, served on the ICJ from **1989 to 1991**. ([sci.gov.in](https://www.sci.gov.in/judge/justice-r-s-pathak/?utm_source=openai))
- **Dalveer Bhandari** joined the ICJ in **2012** and began a second term in **2018**. ([sci.gov.in](https://www.sci.gov.in/judge/justice-dalveer-bhandari/?utm_source=openai))
